landing.pricingFaq.captureA: Lead Capture means saving profiles and lists from LinkedIn or WhatsApp into TargetIQ so you can manage, enrich, and export them.
landing.pricingFaq.enrichA: Enrichment credits are only used when we find contact details. Each email or phone we discover consumes enrich credits based on the rules above.
landing.pricingFaq.addonQ: Can I buy extra enrich credits?
landing.pricingFaq.addonA: Yes. You can purchase add-on enrich credit packs from inside the app at any time without changing your base plan.
landing.pricingFaq.rolloverA: Plan-based capture and enrich quotas reset each billing period and do not roll over. Purchased add-on enrich credits stay in your balance until you use them.
landing.plan.free.feature1: 50 lead captures/month (max 5 per day) and 20 enrichments/month (max 2 per day)
landing.plan.starter.feature1: 500 lead captures/month (max 50 per day) and 200 enrichments/month (max 20 per day)
landing.plan.starter.feature3: Single seat, ideal for solo sellers
landing.plan.pro.feature1: 2000 lead captures/month (max 200 per day) and 1000 enrichments/month (max 100 per day)
landing.plan.enterprise.feature1: 10,000+ lead captures/month (fair use, typically up to 1000 per day) and 5000 enrichments/month (max 500 per day)
landing.plan.enterprise.feature3: Advanced security, SSO, and audit logs
landing.plan.generic.feature1: Access to the TargetIQ lead platform
landing.plan.generic.feature2: Works seamlessly with the Chrome extension
